sides.text: The doctype avoids quirks mode; lang helps accessibility and translation
Viewport meta is required for mobile layouts; defer runs scripts after parsing
sides.code:
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<meta name="description" content="...">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="a.css">
<script src="a.js" defer></script>

One h1 per page
do not skip levels
strong and em carry meaning, b and i only style

sides.text: alt text is required; width and height prevent layout shift
Blocks start on a new line and fill the width; inline flows with text
Landmarks improve accessibility and SEO; use div only when nothing fits
Tables are for data, not layout
Escape < and & in text so they are not parsed as markup
Browsers collapse runs of whitespace except in pre
Every control needs a label; name is the key sent to the server
sides.code:
<form action="/search" method="get">
  <label for="q">Query</label>
  <input id="q" name="q" required>
  <button type="submit">Go</button>
</form>

sides.text: Correct types give mobile keyboards and built-in validation
sides.code:
<input type="email">
<input type="number" min="0" max="10" step="1">
<input type="date">
<input type="password" autocomplete="current-password">
<input type="checkbox"> <input type="radio" name="g">
<input type="file" accept="image/*">

sides.text: Client validation is a convenience; always validate on the server
sides.code: <input required minlength="3" maxlength="20" pattern="[a-z]+" title="lowercase letters">

sides.text: Landmarks and headings for screen readers
Screen reader users navigate by landmarks and headings
Native disclosure and modal without JavaScript

defer keeps order after parsing
async runs as soon as ready
modules defer by default
sides.code:
<script src="a.js" defer></script>
<script src="b.js" async></script>
<script type="module" src="m.js"></script>

sides.text: Prioritize critical resources and lazy-load the rest
Control link previews and duplicate-URL handling
sides.code:
<meta property="og:title" content="...">
<meta property="og:image" content="...">
<link rel="canonical" href="https://x.io/page">

sides.text: Never insert untrusted HTML; CSP limits what the page may load or run
sides.code:
<a rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">
<iframe sandbox="allow-scripts">
<meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'self'">

sides.text: Custom elements with shadow DOM encapsulate markup and style
Canvas is pixels drawn by script; SVG is scalable, scriptable vector markup
sides.code:
<canvas id="c" width="200" height="100"></canvas>
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100"><circle cx="50" cy="50" r="40" fill="tomato"/></svg>
